title: Strict-local exchange on derived global cohomology
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $f':X'\to\operatorname{Spec}B$, and $g':X'\to X$ form a cartesian square with $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let $K$ be any bounded below derived object of abelian etale sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $q\in\mathbb Z$. Let $t$ be the geometric closed B-point with residue field $\kappa(B)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and put $S=H^q(g^{-1}Rf_*K)$ and $T=H^q(Rf'_*g'^{-1}K)$, using [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $e:S\to T$ be homology of the derived exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. Write $P=R\Gamma(X,-)$ and $P'=R\Gamma(X',-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], $U=H^q(PK)$ and $V=H^q(P'(g'^{-1}K))$. Let $p:U\to V$ be $H^q$ of $P$ applied to the derived adjunction unit $K\to Rg'_*g'^{-1}K$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], followed by the Leray identification [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit]. There exist additive equivalences $c_1:S_t\xrightarrow{\sim}U$ and $c_2:T_t\xrightarrow{\sim}V$ such that $c_2(e_t(x))=p(c_1(x))$ for every $x\in S_t$. No properness, quasi-compactness, torsion, or concentration in degree zero is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the canonical derived global germs from inverse Leray, right derivation of germs, and the exact stalk comparison. Strict-local pointed sections and locality prove that both germs, and therefore their derived comparisons, are invertible.

Apply the derived global germ compatibility equation and take homology. Naturality of the exact stalk/homology isomorphism yields j1 ≫ stalk(H(exchange)) = H(p) ≫ j2. Invert j1 and j2, convert their inverse categorical isomorphisms to additive equivalences, and evaluate the equality on x.
